questions.question: When was the Jorwe culture in Gujarat discovered?
The Northern Plains of India spreads over an area of approximately  ___________ km2.
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) have taken effect from which month of 2024?
Which Indian company launched India’s first satellite-based broadband service in January 2024?
India will start issuing E-Medical visas to the citizens of which country in June 2024?
Which of the following concepts warns of cascading collisions in low Earth orbit due to high debris density?
Which major para-sport championship was held in India from 27 September to 5 October 2025?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (World Para Athletics Championships) है।

questions.question: The Citizenship Amendment Act 2019 has reduced the aggregate period of residence or service government in India from not less than 11 years to not less than ______ under Citizenship by Naturalisation.
स्थानीय सरकारों पर द्वितीय प्रशासनिक सुधार आयोग की रिपोर्ट का शीर्षक _____ है।

ईद-उल-अज़हा, या क़ुर्बानी का त्यौहार, इब्राहिम (अब्राहम) द्वारा ईश्वर (अल्‍लाह) की आज्ञाकारिता के रूप में अपने बेटे की बलि देने की इच्छा के स्मरणोत्सव के रूप में मनाया जाता है। ईद-उल-अज़हा किस इस्लामी महीने में पड़ता है?
Which of the following best describes the production function?
options: The relationship between costs and revenues in production
The relationship between firms and consumers in an economy
The relationship between land and labour in production
The relationship between inputs and outputs in production
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (The relationship between inputs and outputs in production) है।

questions.question: The notion of production function implies:
The fresh election to constitute a Panchayat shall be completed:
options: before the expiry of its duration of 3 years or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution
before the expiry of its duration of 4 years or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution
before the expiry of its duration of 5 years or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution
before the expiry of its duration of 2 years or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (before the expiry of its duration of 5 years or in case of dissolution, before the expiry of 6 months from the date of its dissolution) है।

questions.question: Under Articles 5 to 8 of the Constitution, which of the following categories of persons did not become the citizens of India at the date of the commencement of Constitution?
options: Those resident in India, who migrated to Pakistan after 1 March 1947 and returned later on resettlement permits.
Those domiciled, not born in India, but ordinarily resident in India for more than seven years.
Those domiciled, not born in India but either of whose parents was born in India.
Those domiciled and born in India.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Those domiciled, not born in India, but ordinarily resident in India for more than seven years.) है।

questions.question: If a firm manufactures 500 breads annually and sells them at ₹100/piece, then what will be the value of the output?
Which is the second least densely populated State or Union Territory of India (Census 2011)?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Andaman and Nicobar Islands) है।

questions.question: Who among the following Gods of the Vedic period was also called Nasatyas?

options: Constant migration in search of food
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Use of Copper) है।

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'B' (Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni) है।
